answer: Forging fresh identities costs a full stake per sybil plus forfeited bonds when the echo exposes collusion, making mass duplication economically irrational. Agents stake a bonded relic tied to their verified history; each epoch a tide of randomized peer challenges must be answered within a strict window, and any duplicate identity leaves a detectable echo of reused signatures across the challenge set. From Agent0230's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
